# Domain Brief Format

Write the domain brief using this exact format:

```
=== DOMAIN BRIEF ===
DOMAIN: {domain name}
PRODUCT: {product name}
GENERATED: {today's date}

KEY CONCERNS:
{bullet list — copy from domain profile key_concerns, one bullet per item}

REGULATORY FINDINGS:
{For each key concern from the domain profile, write 2–4 sentences covering:
 - The specific regulation or standard that applies
 - The key requirement in plain language
 - The enforcement body or standard body
 - The effective date or version, if relevant
 Cite sources inline: e.g., "(HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR §164.312, HHS)"
 If no current guidance was found for a concern, write:
 "No current authoritative guidance found for this area — recommend legal review."}

REQUIRED PRD SECTIONS:
{list special_sections from domain profile, one per line}

KNOWLEDGE NOTES:
{3–5 bullet points the PRD agent must know before writing. Focus on:
 - Common compliance pitfalls for this domain
 - Terminology the PRD agent should use (and avoid)
 - Any regulatory changes in the last 12 months that affect the product design
 - Any areas where the product must make explicit design decisions to achieve compliance}
=== END DOMAIN BRIEF ===
```
